title: Your thank-you gift
intro: Thanks for sharing what you really think. Pick one gift and one of your published stories, and we'll take it from there.

pdf.title: Print-at-home PDF
pdf.description: A print-ready PDF of one of your stories, sent to the email on your account. Print it, staple it, read it at bedtime.

audiobook.title: Audiobook
audiobook.description: A narrated version of one of your stories. It shows up on the story's listen page when it's ready, usually within a few minutes.

stories.pdfAlreadyRedeemed: You already got the PDF for this one
stories.audiobookHint: Stories that already have an audiobook can't be picked for this gift.
stories.none: You don't have a published story yet. Once you publish one, this gift is ready to claim.

honesty: This gift is on us: it costs no credits and doesn't touch your balance. You get one gift per survey, and once it's on its way it can't be swapped.
retryNote: Last time something went wrong on our side. Nothing was lost, so give it another go.

started.pdfTitle: Your PDF is on its way
started.pdfBody: We're preparing your print-ready PDF and will send it to the email on your account. It usually takes a few minutes. Peek in your spam folder if it plays hide and seek.
started.audiobookBody: The narrator is warming up. When it's done, you'll find it on the story's listen page, and we'll email you too.

processing.title: Your gift is being made
processing.body: It's already in the works, so there's nothing else to do. Check back in a few minutes.

delivered.title: Your gift has been delivered
delivered.pdfBody: The print-ready PDF was sent to the email on your account. Happy printing!
delivered.audiobookBody: Your audiobook is ready and waiting on the story's listen page.

pending.title: Your gift is waiting for a story
pending.body: A gift needs a story to wrap. Publish your first story and it unlocks right away. We'll email you when it does.

expired.title: This gift has expired
expired.body: The claim window has closed, and we're sorry you missed it. Thank you for sharing your thoughts with us anyway. It really helped.

notFound.title: We can't find this gift
notFound.body: This link doesn't match your account. Gifts can only be claimed by the person who received the invitation, so check that you're signed in with the same email.

errors.generic: Something went wrong and we couldn't start your gift. Nothing was used, so please try again in a moment.
errors.loadFailed: We couldn't load your gift. Please try again.
errors.audiobook_exists: That story already has an audiobook. Pick another story.
errors.story_not_found: We couldn't find that story among your published stories.
errors.story_not_published: Only published stories can be used for this gift.
errors.reward_type_not_allowed: That gift isn't available in this survey.
errors.already_redeemed: This gift has already been claimed.
errors.pending_story: Publish a story first and this gift will unlock.
errors.product_in_progress: This story already has one of these in the works. Pick another story or check back soon.
errors.launch_failed: We couldn't start the job just now. Nothing was used. Please try again.
errors.previous_attempt_failed: The previous attempt didn't go through. Please try again.

banner.eligibleTitle: A thank-you gift is waiting for you
banner.eligibleBody: Pick an audiobook or a print-at-home PDF for one of your stories. It's on us.
banner.retryTitle: Your gift needs one more step
banner.retryBody: Something hiccupped last time. Give it another go, nothing was used.
